title: In Silico, In Vitro, and In Vivo Investigations of Anticancer Properties of a Novel Platinum (II) Complex and Its PLGA Encapsulated Form.
authors: Shabaninejad, Zahra; Dehshiri, Mahdiyar; Modarres Mousavi, Sayed Mostafa; Nikkhah, Maryam; Shirian, Sadegh; Moradi, Sajad; Nabavizadeh, S Masoud
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过计算与实验探究新型铂(II)配合物与DNA的结合及抗癌活性，并利用分子动力学模拟预测其PLGA包封复合物的稳定性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，方法上仅部分使用MD模拟，整体相关性中等。
abstract: In recent years, the development of multinuclear platinum complexes has introduced a new era in platinum-based chemotherapy, offering improved cytotoxicity and the ability to overcome resistance. However, these complexes still face challenges related to water solubility, biodistribution, and targeted delivery. This study provides a comprehensive investigation of a novel platinum (II) complex, [Pt(2)(mu-bpy-2H) (Me)(2)(dmso)(2)] (C1), focusing on its DNA binding ability and anticancer activity. Computational and experimental approaches revealed that C1 binding to guanine bases and involvement of intercalative interactions. C1 exhibited cytotoxicity in both cisplatin sensitive and resistant cancer cell lines. To enhance the pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic properties of C1, it was encapsulated using poly (D, L-lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA). Molecular dynamic simulations predicted the formation of stable C1/PLGA complexes during the early stages of simulation. Encapsulated C1 showed superior antitumor activity with significantly reduced side effects in tumor-bearing mouse models. In conclusion, this study highlights the novel platinum (II) complex C1 as a promising anticancer agent, especially when paired with PLGA encapsulation to improve its effectiveness and reduce side effects.
abstract_zh: 近年来，多核铂配合物的发展开启了铂类化疗的新纪元，提供了增强的细胞毒性和克服耐药性的能力。然而，这些配合物仍面临水溶性、生物分布和靶向递送方面的挑战。本研究对一种新型铂(II)配合物[Pt(2)(mu-bpy-2H)(Me)(2)(dmso)(2)]（C1）进行了全面研究，重点关注其DNA结合能力和抗癌活性。计算和实验方法揭示，C1与鸟嘌呤碱基结合并涉及嵌入相互作用。C1在顺铂敏感和耐药癌细胞系中均表现出细胞毒性。为增强C1的药代动力学和药效学特性，采用聚(D,L-乳酸-共-乙醇酸)（PLGA）对其进行封装。分子动力学模拟预测在模拟早期阶段形成稳定的C1/PLGA复合物。封装后的C1在荷瘤小鼠模型中显示出优越的抗肿瘤活性，并显著减少副作用。总之，本研究强调了新型铂(II)配合物C1作为一种有前景的抗癌药物，尤其是与PLGA封装结合使用时，能提高其有效性并减少副作用。
